name: mobile-library-light
prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit. Create one LIGHT mode counterpart of the supplied revised Wave Player mockup. This is an exact paired UI view, not a new layout.

Preserve all positions, proportions, compact header spacing, content, visual art, waveform, control sizes and ZERO-RADIUS SHARP SQUARE Pause and selected Repeat backgrounds. No circular or rounded control surfaces. Preserve Phosphor glyphs. Preserve three-font role hierarchy: Inter Medium title and library track names, TX-02 Regular metadata, counts, filenames and times, Departure Mono small PLAYING/SELECTED status labels and A/B markers. Reinforce TX-02's true monospaced character in supporting metadata (equal width character advances, technical humanist mono; not proportional sans) and keep Departure Mono distinct with restrained pixel-cut forms. Main title stays Inter about22 CSS px with normal tracking. Main title and metadata remain a tight two-line group; no large gap or padding.

Change palette to warm near-white ground #f4f4f0, white surface #fffffc, charcoal ink #171714, readable secondary gray, fine neutral rules #d6d6ce and pale-gray square selected/Pause surfaces. Waveform uses charcoal played portion and gray remaining portion.

Preserve MOBILE internal Library view with back arrow, inline 5 files count, plus, five rows, compact session footer, persistent waveform and transport. NO oscilloscope in this view.

No tabs, central A/B text button, theme toggle, visible volume slider or additional controls. The only A/B letters permitted are existing loop editing boundary markers/readouts. Keep exact text and all five library records if present. Preserve image aspect ratio and caption outside UI exactly "Design fixture — simulated waveform and playback". ONE image.
